explanation: Gene report: the differential-expression table leads with every track at raw p < 0.05, FDR survivors by q then nominal tracks (FDR fails) by p. Each row carries a data-tier and is labelled under its q (FDR < 0.05 or p < 0.05 only); the q is named in its cell because the column headers are screen-reader only, and nominal rows show their p beside log2FC, uncoloured. Pathway report: each dataset block leads with its tracks at p < 0.05 (FDR, then nominal, each by |NES|), the DIR column becomes CALL showing the shared TierLabel, and the headline, notes, block and category summaries and Show-all toggles name the nominal tier. SigPill, now unused, is removed from forestReport and FOREST_GRID's last column widens to fit the labels. Significant counts, directions and colours still follow the FDR call; contracts and routes are unchanged.
